about: The one table of the pages the UI walk visits (R19, plan §3 S9, audit D §3.2 and §4 S5): which router pattern a view belongs to, which of the six page templates it is built on, the style budget it is held to, the kinds of section it may stack, and whether its first row is clicked.

scripts/ops/ui-walk.mjs reads it (embedded: the release switch mounts that one file only, `node scripts/ops/embed-walk-tables.mjs` writes the copy and a test holds it equal), apps/server/test/uiWalk.test.mjs and apps/web/src/app/pageTemplates.test.ts read it for the router coverage, and apps/web/src/test/pageComposition.test.tsx reads the templates' slots.

A view is a name the walk's report uses (`vcr-trial@2` is the second study's trial tab and is the view `vcr-trial`). `route` is the address the walk opens; a view without one is found from the deployment's own lists (`discovered`) or is a tab of a module page (`module`, `tab`).

`budget` names a row of `budgets` (the reading page's 8 / 5 / 3 when absent) and `budgetOverride` changes single numbers of it, each with the measure and the reason in `budgetNote`. There is no list of pages excused from their budget: a page that has to spend more says so here, with the measurement behind it, and a debt that is not a budget is an entry of ui-walk-baseline.json with an owner and a day.

`family` is the set of pages that share one tab strip (or one route): their titles start on one left edge; a page of its own kind (a record: a zone, a card, an author, an event, a document) is a family of one. A module's views (`module`) keep the same visible workflow rail and one contextual view selector; both 虚拟临床研究 and 循证 GEO retain their step states during conversation, including on a phone (owner, 2026-10-20). `workflow` says how a module navigates: `compact`, the steps folded beside one pinned 「查看：」 result selector; `rail`, 循证 GEO since its V3 plan (2026-10-23, §一.1 and §3.1, written at the owner's request), the eight steps are the one business navigation, a step's own views are a contextual 「分析视图」 select, and no project-level 「查看：」 selector is drawn; a module row without one keeps the rail and one pinned selector (虚拟临床研究).

`templates` says what each template may hold: `tablist`, `toolbar` and `stepRail` are `allowed`, `none` or (for the rail) `every-tab`; a reading page may carry the switch of its own document (a GEO answer's date, a document's 内容 / 原文 on a phone), which DESIGN.md does not forbid it. `orphans: content` marks a page made of text (a reading page): a sentence standing alone on it is its content, so the orphan-sentence budget does not apply there. `longViewports` is how many windows tall a page of the template may be before it needs contents: a reading page needs them from six, anything else contents or a list read a page at a time from twelve.
